name: University of Birmingham
description: The University of Birmingham received its royal charter in 1900, growing out of Mason Science College, and was England's first civic 'red brick' university. It is a member of the Russell Group, with its main campus at Edgbaston.
whyIncluded: The University of Birmingham is among the 10 universities in the United Kingdom most chosen by international students (12,485 non-UK students in 2024-25, per HESA), per the FinexisEdu shortlist research of October 2026.

programmes.name: Mechanical Engineering MEng
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for international students starting in 2027, as listed by a course directory (Birmingham shows it only by country). Birmingham keeps the first-year fee for the whole course.
programmes.notes: Secondary source: Birmingham's course pages show only the UK fee as text and put the international fee behind a country selector that is not readable without JavaScript; the international fees pages (study/international/fees, study/undergraduate/fees-funding/tuition, study/postgraduate/taught/fees-funding/taught-fees) give no figures, the UCAS entry lists the UK fee only, and no official fee table or PDF could be found (checked 2026-10-07). Figure read from the Studyportals listing for University of Birmingham (Birmingham, UK campus, not Dubai), start date 27 September 2027, '30,600 GBP / year'. Replace with the official figure when it can be read. Studyportals lists the programme as 'Mechanical Engineering (Hons)', MEng, 48 months. Fee policy (official, birmingham.ac.uk/study/undergraduate/fees-funding/tuition, read 2026-10-07): 'The fee paid in your first year will remain constant with no inflationary increase for the duration of your course, with the exception of the International Foundation Programme and clinical courses', so cohortLocked is true. No compulsory fees besides tuition.
